newsitem.title: UK: Mosvold Shipping confirms VLCC acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Mosvold Shipping confirms VLCC acquisition.

text.p: Norwegian tanker operator Mosvold Shipping ASA today confirmed its acquisition of two 1970s-built very large crude carriers (VLCCs).
Mosvold said in a statement it has lifted subjects for the financing of the two VLCCs and that the acquisition of the Mare Champion and Mare Discovery had become unconditional.
It also said it had received board approval for a two for one rights issue totalling Norwegian crowns 237 million as well as deletion of the company's limitation to 50 percent Norwegian ownership.
The rights issue will finance the acquisition of the vessels which have been valued at $12 million each by shipping brokers.
Mosvold said the 315,700 dwt sisterships which were built in 1974 and 1975 would be drydocked for upgrading at a yard in Dubai as soon as possible after taking delivery of them.
"The Mare Discovery is expected to be taken over in South Africa next week and will change name to Mosqueen," Mosvold said.
The Mare Champion will be delivered in Europe during the first half of June and renamed Mosking, the company added.
The company is expected to trade the vessels until 1999 when their next special survey is due. Their future will then be reviewed.
